title: Antero Midstream Announces Third Quarter 2026 Return of Capital and Earnings Release Date and Conference Call
summary: DENVER, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Antero Midstream Corporation (NYSE: AM) ("Antero Midstream" or the "Company") today…...
body_markdown:
DENVER


, Oct. 14, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Antero Midstream Corporation (NYSE: AM) ("Antero Midstream" or the "Company") today announced that the Board of Directors of Antero Midstream declared a cash dividend of $0.225 per share for the third quarter of 2026. The Company also repurchased approximately 1.3 million shares during the third quarter. In addition, Antero Midstream announced plans to issue its third quarter 2026 earnings on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange.


**Third Quarter 2026 Return of Capital**


The Board of Directors of Antero Midstream declared a cash dividend of $0.225 per share for the third quarter of 2026, or $0.90 per share on an annualized basis. The dividend will be payable on November 11, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 28, 2026. This represents the 48th consecutive quarterly dividend or distribution paid since Antero Midstream Partners LP's initial public offering in November 2014. In addition, during the third quarter of 2026, Antero Midstream repurchased 1.3 million shares for approximately $27 million. Antero Midstream had $283 million of remaining share repurchase capacity under its $500 million authorized share repurchase program as of September 30, 2026.


**Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call**


Antero Midstream plans to issue its third quarter 2026 earnings on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. A conference call is scheduled on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 10:00 am MT to discuss the financial and operational results. A brief Q&A session for security analysts will immediately follow the discussion of the results. To participate in the call, dial in at 877-407-9126 (U.S.), or +1 201-493-6751 (International) and reference "Antero Midstream." A telephone replay of the call will be available until Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 10:00 am MT at 877-660-6853 (U.S.) or +1 201-612-7415 (International) using the conference ID: 13758949. To access the live webcast and view the related earnings conference call presentation, visit Antero Midstream's website at[www.anteromidstream.com](http://www.anteromidstream.com/) . The webcast will be archived for replay until Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 10:00 am MT.


*Antero Midstream Corporation is a Delaware corporation that owns, operates and develops midstream gathering, compression, processing and fractionation assets located in the Appalachian Basin, as well as integrated water assets that primarily service Antero Resources Corporation's properties.*
